s: This was a huge boon for both the service and the song, since folks could legally download it for 99 cents without buying the whole album - a very big deal at the time. This got the song on a lot of iPods and helped make it ubiquitous. Thanks to the iTunes exposure, "Hey Ya!" became the first song in history to rack up one million downloads, making it the first song to achieve Platinum status as a download.
